description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'ReportingMethodConfigurationDao' used for managing 'ReportingMethod' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting reporting methods, as well as checking for existing names and retrieving IDs in use.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing 'ReportingMethod' entities, including CRUD operations and utility functions.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Persists a ReportingMethod entity to the database.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its ID.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of ReportingMethod entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Counts the number of ReportingMethod entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ReportingMethod entities based on search filters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes multiple ReportingMethod entities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a ReportingMethod with the given name exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of reporting methods currently in use, linked to ReportTo entities.
